name: mat_c
source: WorldClim 2.1 BIO1 (annual mean temperature 1970-2000), 30 arc-seconds; https://www.worldclim.org
derivation: Extract BIO1 at the site; the calibration used the centroid of the 1 km INSPIRE (ETRS89-LAEA) cell of each BWI tract. Natural units; scale_env() applies the pooled mean/sd of the calibration (env_scales.csv).

name: map_mm
derivation: Extract BIO12 at the site. Natural units; scale_env() scales it.

name: elev_m
source: Elevation of the site (calibration: the BWI tract elevation b0_tab.HoeheNN; WorldClim elevation where missing)
derivation: Any DEM at the true position; the calibration's range is 0-1,700 m.

name: management
unit: tier 0-3 (constant over a simulation or per decade)
source: Regular harvest intensity of the stand, derived in the calibration from the BWI remeasurement: share of the start basal area of the tallied trees removed by regular harvest over the decade (calamity salvage in 2012-2022 counted as mortality, not harvest)
derivation: 0 = no tree harvested in the decade, 1 = up to 5 % of the start basal area, 2 = 5-20 %, 3 = more than 20 %. For a simulation choose the tier that describes the intended regular harvest level (0 for an unmanaged run; 2-3 for ordinary German production forests, where the calibration has most of its managed stands). The tier shifts growth, mortality and recruitment rates on the link scale by species-specific slopes; it is a post-treatment covariate of the calibration (the tier is derived from the same decade's removals), so results should be reported as a range over tiers 0-3 rather than for one tier. The harvested trees themselves are not removed from the simulated stand by the tier: the tier raises the removal (mortality) rate of the modelled stand.

name: drought2
unit: standardised anomaly (sd units; 0 = long-term mean; negative = drier)
source: DWD Climate Data Center, 1 km monthly grids of modelled soil moisture (% of usable field capacity, under grass over sandy loam), https://opendata.dwd.de/climate_environment/CDC/grids_germany/monthly/soil_moist/ (CC BY 4.0)
derivation: Per site: mean soil moisture over April-September of each year 2000-2022 (the calibration baseline), z-standardised with the site's own mean and sd over those years; drought2 of year t = (z_t + z_(t-1)) / 2, the mean of the current and the previous year's anomaly. For a scenario, set drought2 directly: 0 = an average year, about -1 = a dry year like 2003 or 2018 at most German sites, -1.5 to -2.3 = the driest site-years of the calibration (its 1 % quantile is -2.3; more negative values extrapolate a logit-linear response). One env row per annual transition: row k drives simulated year k; the initial state is the init cohort, there is no year-0 env row.
